title: Security System Service Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Security System Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Security System Service Inspection Checklist covers alarm panel, access-control device, sensor, camera, credential path, and monitoring interface. The site security coordinator records Security System Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Security System Service Inspection Checklist keeps Security System Service exceptions visible until the site security coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Security System Service Inspection Checklist at controlled premises, panel, door, zone, camera view, and monitoring point. Document alarm panel, access-control device, sensor, camera, credential path, and monitoring interface identity before Security System Service begins. Compare alarm panel, access-control device, sensor, camera, credential path, and monitoring interface findings with stated Security System Service criteria; route unresolved Security System Service issues to authorized security-system reviewer. For Security System Service Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Security System Service. Ask authorized security-system reviewer to review Security System Service conditions beyond the site security coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Security System Service, identify responsible parties, controlled premises, panel, door, zone, camera view, and monitoring point, and the linked alarm panel, access-control device, sensor, camera, credential path, and monitoring interface source.

fields.label: Panel, door, zone, camera, or device identifier
Scope, test window, account, and credential ID

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Security System Service facts for alarm panel, access-control device, sensor, camera, credential path, and monitoring interface; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Security System Service inspection checks
items: Panel, controller, power, communication, and trouble status
Door, lock, reader, request-to-exit, and contact response
Sensor, alarm, notification, and monitoring transmission
Camera view, recording, timestamp, retention, and obstruction state
Test bypass, restoration, event history, and user acceptance

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Security System Service finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Site Security Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Credential or recording privacy boundary exceeded
Monitoring or critical device cannot be restored
Monitoring notification and full restoration confirmation
blocks.guidance: Pause Security System Service when protection, monitoring, credential, privacy, or life-safety interface control is unresolved. Retain the available Security System Service proof and route unresolved alarm panel, access-control device, sensor, camera, credential path, and monitoring interface scope to site security coordinator.
